Hi Sean / Ben / Karthik —

Thanks again for confirming the May 26 workshop at our San Mateo office. Attached is the attendee preference form with travel windows. A couple quick asks before we finalize: 

- We have two contractor consultants (Alex R. and Priya M.) who need to travel from Austin — can you confirm whether Redwood will cover their flights or if Novum should bill them? (Procurement is looped.)
- Our team prefers arrivals between 10:00–13:00 local so we can do a quick prep session. Can you confirm seat-class rules and if early check-in is possible?

Attachment: Novum_Preference_Form.pdf (names + windows + seating)

If we can get PNRs and billing instructions by Wednesday EOD that would be ideal — procurement has a PO but they prefer invoices to route to the PO number on file.

Thanks,

Tara Singh
Senior Program Manager | Novum Therapeutics

Hi Tara —

Appreciate the preferences. Quick summary / proposal from our side: 

- Redwood will book and cover flights for the three core Redwood attendees (me, Ben, Karthik).
- Contractors (Alex R., Priya M.) — Novum can bill these directly to the PO. We'll book the tickets to lock fares but mark them as \"Bill to client / remit to Novum PO-9987.\" Please confirm this charge path with procurement (copied).
- Arrival window is doable — we will prioritize flights landing 10:00–13:00 local. If there are only late options we will flag them immediately and propose an earlier outbound from Austin.

I've attached an updated itinerary draft with proposed flight legs and the two contractor legs separated for billing. Ben, please confirm the outbound time for your earliest preference (I know you preferred an afternoon outbound last time).

Attachments: Novum_Workshop_Itinerary_v3.pdf

Thanks,

Sean Gallagher
Head of Field Sales, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

Thanks Sean — I reviewed the draft and pushed a couple of constraints back to the airline. Key points: 

- Contractors (Alex R., Priya M.) — we can hold the fares on a client-bill basis but Novum needs to provide the PO number now to secure the lower fares. If PO-9987 is confirmed we’ll ticket and flag invoices to route to that PO.
- For Redwood team: proposed legs (all local times):
  - SFO: Sean — AA 372, depart 07:20, arrive 09:05 (preferred)
  - SFO: Ben — UA 214, depart 12:10, arrive 13:55 (afternoon outbound ok)
  - SFO: Karthik — DL 600, depart 06:50, arrive 08:40 (early outbound to attend prep)

- Seat class: standard economy with one domestic upgrade allowed (earlier check-in / paid seat assignment) for senior staff — we will allocate upgrades to cover Karthik where needed.

I've attached an expense-routing spreadsheet that shows invoice fields we need from procurement plus the PO. Please confirm the PO and whether Novum requires separate invoices for the two contractor tickets.

Attachment: Expense_Instructions.xlsx

If Procurement can confirm PO-9987 today, we will ticket contractor legs and send PNRs by EOD Wednesday.

Best,

Ben Carter
